  • Failure Library path: SqueegeeSpeed < LSL → Aperture overfill → Solder bridging
  • Attributed: the model attributes 19 of 23 boards with solder bridging (83%) to this root cause. Needs 20% or more.
  • Predicted mechanism: aperture overfill on 17 of 19 attributed boards (89%). Needs 50% or more.
  • Model agreement with AOI on stg-B0005: 99%. Needs 90% or more.
  • What-if: with squeegee speed (70 mm/s) at nominal, predicted boards with solder bridging fall from 21 to 5.
Suggested action: Raise the speed to nominal (70 mm/s).
